title: Tendinous
summary: TEN'DINOUS, adjective [Latin tendines, tendons, from tendo, to stretch.] 1. Pertaining to a tendon; partaking of the nature of tendons. 2. Full of tendons; sinewy; as nervous and tendinous parts.
